html_source: Coat of arms of the 8th Earl of Kildare, Gerald FitzGerald. The Cross of St. George (red on a white background) and the motto of the Order of the Garter (Honi soit qui mal y pense) show the Norman roots of these Anglo-Irish lords. Source: Wikimedia Commons.

Coat of arms of the 8th Earl of Kildare, Gerald
